description: Assign secondary IPs to a network interface. Provide either secondaryIpList (specific IPs) or secondaryIpCount (auto-assign count).

networkInterfaceNo.description: Network interface number to assign secondary IPs to

secondaryIpCount.description: Number of secondary IPs to auto-assign

secondaryIpList.description: List of specific secondary IP addresses to assign

name: ncloud_assign_secondary_ips
